Expected output SHAPE for s05-provider-streaming.

LLM output is non-deterministic, so the -live runs will differ. The OFFLINE
demo (`go run .` with no flags) replays a recorded Anthropic SSE fixture through
the real decoder, so its shape IS reproducible. Use it to confirm the chunk
pipeline works.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------
$ GOWORK=off go run .
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
== offline demo: replaying a recorded Anthropic SSE stream ==
  [usage] in=42 out=1
  [text]  "Let me "
  [text]  "read that file."
  [tool]  start id=toolu_01 name=read_file
  [tool]  input += "{\"path\":"
  [tool]  input += "\"main.go\"}"
  [usage] in=0 out=17
  [done]

== assembled response ==
stop_reason: tool_use  usage: in=42 out=17
text: "Let me read that file."
tool_use: read_filemap[path:main.go]

Notes:
- Each [text]/[tool]/[usage]/[done] line is ONE normalized StreamChunk off the
  wire, in arrival order. Text and tool input arrive as small deltas.
- The final "assembled response" is what assembleResponse folds the chunk
  stream back into: one text block + one tool_use block (with the two partial
  JSON fragments concatenated and parsed), stop_reason flipped to tool_use, and
  input tokens from message_start + output tokens from message_delta.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------
$ GOWORK=off go run . -live -provider deepseek -prompt "say hi"   (needs a key)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
== live stream from deepseek ==
Hi there! ...text streams in token by token...
[done]

------------------------------------------------------------------------------
$ GOWORK=off go test -count=1 ./...
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
ok  	learn-cline/s05	0.50s
